A Strong Showcase of Balance and Umami
Aug 2026 • Solo
Tapioca Pearl in Mushroom Soup, Chicken Meatball — The soup had a nice depth and earthiness, while the tapioca pearls were soft and chewy. Overall, I thought the dish was well-balanced, and the chicken meatball complemented the mushroom soup really well. However, I honestly think the dish would have been just as good without the tapioca pearls. While they added some texture, I didn’t feel like they contributed enough to the overall dish to be necessary.

Grilled Alaska Black Cod, Dashi Beurre Blanc, Lobster Oil — The black cod was moist, buttery, and cooked perfectly. The dashi beurre blanc really gave life to the dish, adding a rich umami depth that complemented the fish well.

Excellent evening
Mar 2024 • Friends
I visited Fashionista Cafe March 18th with my best friend for dinner and it was a wonderful experience. Very nice and friendly waiter who meets you at the door and kindly follows you to your table. 
The service our waiter provided us with was excellent. Good at presenting the dish as well as following up with more wine/water during the course of the evening, and without making it awkward or weird which can happen sometimes. 
The food was very good, for my starter i got the Quail breast which was cooked to almost perfection, followed up by the pork tenderloin which was cooked to perfection! 
And ended the evening with the orange caramel creme. the orange and caramel complimented each other very well and you could really taste the high quality ingredients in the dessert as well as the other dishes, which is very important for me when i fine dine. 
The manager/owner (not sure) also came over to have a chat about the food and experience during the evening which made the experience even more personal which i really liked. He was extremely kind and we ended up chatting for quite some time about various topics. 
We ended up giving a deserved big tip, as our waiter provided us with great service and nice behavior during the course of the evening. 
Very worth it for the price! Would recommend it to anyone that wants high quality dishes combined with class and elegant service.

A fashion house with great food
Dec 2023 • Family

However, I felt that the table they gave us, although was very pretty, a bit too small for our food. My family ordered their set menu while I had the ala carte menu. We were happy with their food and service. There wasn’t many customers around when we were there. It’s a nice place to chill in.
